title: SurplusSkimmed event under-represents the buffered-path beneficiaries — no event records per-client buffer redirection
story: story-042 — per-client setAsideBuffer added to skimSurplus
description: On the buffered path, _distributeBuffer (L511-L519) performs underlyingToken.safeTransfer(clients[i], buf) for every surplus-bearing client whose setAsideBufferSize[client] > 0. The only event emitted is SurplusSkimmed(token, client, msg.sender, surplus, recipient) in _accrueSurplusShares (L484), which (a) reports the SNAPSHOT surplus in vault-asset terms (pre-redeem/pre-swap), not the actual underlying received per client; (b) names recipient as the receiver even when most of the proceeds for that client actually go to clients[i]. No event marks the buffer-redirected transfer. Downstream indexers reconstructing fund flow from events will mis-attribute receipts: every wei landing in any clients[i] via the buffered path is invisible to event consumers.
impact: No direct loss — all funds reach protocol-owned addresses. Downstream integrators (indexers, accounting systems, SYA's reconciliation logic) reading SurplusSkimmed as the authoritative receipt event will mis-attribute proceeds: every wei routed to clients[i] via _distributeBuffer is invisible to the event consumer. Off-chain accounting drift. The submodule's own CLAUDE.md note ('skimSurplus return value vs SurplusSkimmed events') only documents the SUM-vs-RETURN-VALUE drift, not the RECIPIENT mismatch.
attackPath: 1. Buffered-path skim executes; _distributeBuffer performs safeTransfer to each surplus-bearing client.
2. Only one event fires: SurplusSkimmed(token, client, msg.sender, surplus, recipient) from _accrueSurplusShares — naming recipient as the destination.
3. Integrator reconstructing fund flow attributes the entire surplus to recipient; the per-client buffer transfers are missed.
assumptions: At least one client has setAsideBufferSize > 0 (buffered path active).
An external integrator relies on SurplusSkimmed for fund-flow reconstruction.
externalRequirements: Any indexer or reconciliation pipeline consuming SurplusSkimmed events.
recommendation: Either (a) emit a new SurplusBuffered(token, client, amount) event in _distributeBuffer when buf > 0, and a SurplusForwarded(token, recipient, amount) for the remainder; or (b) extend SurplusSkimmed with a bufferAmount field and emit it in _distributeBuffer rather than _accrueSurplusShares; or (c) document the event semantics under the buffered path in IYieldStrategy.sol NatSpec.

foldingCandidate.rationale: Both findings cover the integration-transparency surface of the buffered path (event-recipient drift + return-value-path-dependent semantics). qa-bundler should decide whether to bundle into a single 'buffered-path integration transparency' QA item or keep separate (audiences differ: event indexer vs return-value caller).

references: submodule CLAUDE.md (note on return value vs events drift)
qaBundleNote: Folded with L-06 into single QA item 'Buffered-path integration transparency' under L-05 label; L-06 retained in ledger as its own entry but reported jointly. See qa-report.md L-05 section sub-points (a) event drift and (b) return-value semantics.
